gold_note: Anomuran phylogram, 34 tips. The root is drawn as a trichotomy (Dromia dehaani, Polycheles aculeatus, the rest). Outside-corpus case: chosen to test whether the tool generalises beyond dinosaur figures, not drawn at random. Topology transcribed from the figure and checked node by node; topology only.
